answer_1.quote: In this paper, we explore the task of Recipe-Grounded Conversation, where the dialogue agent is expected to converse with a user to walk him/her through the cooking procedure of a recipe, while answering any questions that might arise along the way

answer_2.quote: We report the following automatic evaluation metrics: BLEU, BLEURT, the average length of the outputs and the diversity scores based on the proportion of unique n-grams over the total number of n-grams.

answer_4.quote: we ask three annotators to analyze the system outputs and manually categorize their errors. We also ask the annotators to rate the correctness of each system response, using a 5-point Likert scale
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated correctness on a 5-point Likert scale and categorized errors into one of four types: wrong order, irrelevant, lack of information, wrong information.
